project_context.description: Weekly CRM Report Dashboard for college/business school to parse Excel lead/application dumps, calculate metrics, and track week-over-week trends.

rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080; always tint with blue/slate.
Color is Function Only. 95% of UI should be monochrome, using brand_primary only to guide action.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look) & Flat Solid surfaces. NO Glassmorphism for data apps.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-slate-200). Use border-collapse for grid/table views.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for interactive cards on hover, otherwise flat.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. Max 4px to 8px border-radius (rounded or rounded-md). No excessive pill shapes except for status badges.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

bento_grid.primary_data: col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-full (The main Program x Lead-Stage Matrix)

grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text/labels. Right-align numerical data in tables. Center-align only empty states or specific standalone CTA blocks.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Visible navigation bar or sidebar. Header MUST have a solid background (bg-white border-b border-slate-200).

components.tables: Shadcn UI Table. Heavily customized for density. Sticky header, 1px subtle borders on cells, alternate row backgrounds (bg-slate-50/50).
components.forms: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Select. Never use native HTML inputs. Use for 'Amount Spent' entries and Settings/Rules panel.
components.buttons: Shadcn UI Button. Sharp edges (rounded-md). Explicit hover states (hover:bg-primary/90).
components.uploader: Custom Drag & Drop zone using raw HTML/Tailwind. border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 hover:border-primary bg-slate-50 p-12 flex flex-col items-center.
components.toasts: Sonner (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner). Use for upload success, calculation errors, save confirmations.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts for Week-over-week trend visualization (Line/Bar charts). Keep colors strictly accessible and within the functional palette.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit color changes (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-primary). Subtle transform (-translate-y-[2px]) on cards.
motion_and_interactions.focus: High contrast ring: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out). NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders for tables/charts while data is processing.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text (WCAG AA). 3:1 for large text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.testing: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-lead-dump-btn', data-testid='metric-total-leads').

media_and_assets.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react). Run: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react. Use Duotone or Regular weights. No emojis.
media_and_assets.images: Not required for this data-heavy internal dashboard. Do not use placeholders. Use typography, abstract geometric SVG patterns, or Phosphor icons for empty states.
media_and_assets.3d_libraries: Not applicable/Overkill for internal data matrix reporting. Focus on clear 2D data visualization.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: 'yarn add xlsx @phosphor-icons/react recharts sonner'.
Create a robust parsing utility for Excel files using the 'xlsx' library to handle the Lead and Application dumps.
Build a Program × Lead-Stage matrix component that dynamically generates columns based on Lead-Stage rules provided in the Settings panel.
Implement a state management solution (Context or Zustand) to store historical weekly reports for week-over-week comparison.
Ensure the 'Amount Spent' inputs automatically recalculate 'Cost per Application' (CPA) and 'Relevant leads' metrics upon change.
Add an 'Export to Excel' feature that reverse-generates a clean .xlsx report matching the generated matrix table.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions like dropdowns or toasts; rely strictly on Shadcn and Sonner.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, even in flat designs (e.g., sticky headers above tables).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in CSS).
Always use modern button styles matching the dashboard archetype (sharp or 4px radius, clear interactive states).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use the specified Phosphor icon library.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure all components from Shadcn are thoroughly customized to remove default 'Vercel-look' styles where they conflict with the Swiss High-Contrast archetype.
